subtitles.en: I think the plans for the build out have been reasonably well known.
subtitles.zh: 我认为扩建计划已经广为人知。

subtitles.en: So for people who are looking at the SpaceX equity IPO, they had a really good understanding of how much money was going to be spent over the next handful of years.
subtitles.zh: 所以关注SpaceX权益资产IPO的人，很清楚未来几年要花多少钱。

subtitles.en: And quite frankly, you can't have negative free cash flow.
subtitles.zh: 坦白说，你不能有负的自由现金流。

subtitles.en: That's 20, 30, 40 billion dollars annually without access to low cost cheap capital.
subtitles.zh: 每年200亿、300亿、400亿美元的缺口，没有低成本资金是做不到的。

subtitles.en: A bid pool that was equities. They raised 85 billion dollars of equity.
subtitles.zh: 权益资产认购池，他们筹集了850亿美元。

subtitles.en: They're probably going to need another hundred billion dollars of debt.
subtitles.zh: 他们可能还需要另外1000亿美元的债务。

subtitles.en: So if you had plans to borrow that much and thought you can do it in the junk markets, you'd be thought of as crazy.
subtitles.zh: 所以如果你计划借那么多，还认为能在垃圾债市场做到，那会被认为疯了。

subtitles.en: So I think this is pretty well understood. I do get it why people say, how are these ratings so high?
subtitles.zh: 所以我认为这很好理解。我明白为什么人们说，评级怎么这么高？

subtitles.en: And I think you just need to look into the future a little bit and look at the past.
subtitles.zh: 我认为你只需要稍微展望未来，回顾过去。

subtitles.en: One is they're sitting on a hundred billion dollars a cash. Two is they're committed to IG ratings and reasonably low leverage.
subtitles.zh: 一是他们坐拥1000亿美元现金。二是他们致力于**级评级和合理低杠杆。

subtitles.en: Three is their liquidity profile looks fantastic. They have access to huge pools of both equity and debt capital.
subtitles.zh: 第三，他们的流动性状况极佳，能接触到庞大的权益和债务资本池。

subtitles.en: And their burn rate is going to take them three or four years to even get through the amount of capital that they have today.
subtitles.zh: 而且他们的资金消耗率需要三四年才能耗尽现有资本。

subtitles.en: So do you want a question where this company might be in five years and what leverage is going to look like?
subtitles.zh: 那么，你想问这家公司五年后会怎样，杠杆率会如何？

subtitles.en: And are they going to be successful? I think it's a good debate. And I think when you're copying, are they an aerospace and defense company, are they communications company, are they an AI tech company, that all of that creates, I think, more opportunity
subtitles.zh: 他们会成功吗？这是个好问题。当你思考他们是航空航天与国防公司、通信公司还是AI科技公司时，所有这些都创造了更多机会。

subtitles.en: for bondholders because the bond deal gets priced probably wider than inherently it should.
subtitles.zh: 对债券持有人而言，因为债券发行定价可能比内在价值更宽。
